documented_probe: C-d1d1b8cb (write and save a reusable fine-tuning script): covered directly and exercised at hard difficulty; the verifier re-executes the delivered script on hidden folds with unseen sizes, class balances and rule perturbations, enforces the fixed base-checkpoint path, snapshot divergence from base, accuracy >= 0.90 per fold, and the documented error contract (missing label column / zero-row fold must exit non-zero).
notes: Single focused deliverable pair: a reusable fine-tuning script plus the artifact it produces on the visible fold. Scenario (print-shop press-fold threshold drift over a frozen 3-class 16->24->3 checkpoint) is independent of umber-vault's full split/train/predict/bag pipeline. Base checkpoint is calibrated below 0.90 on every fold (0.82-0.91), so copying base fails; a correct capped-epoch fine-tune reaches ~1.0 (oracle-verified on all folds). Rubric: reasoning_depth (training-loop design, error contract), hidden_case_generalization (3 hidden folds with distinct drifts/sizes), adversarial_inputs (malformed folds), quantitative_correctness (accuracy threshold), dependent_stages (artifact must be produced by running the script).
